content: Forward head posture refers to the anterior positioning of the cervical spine, where the head is positioned forward relative to the body's vertical alignment. This condition is a postural issue that can arise from various factors, including sleeping with the head elevated excessively high, prolonged use of computers, insufficient development of back muscle strength, and deficiencies in essential nutrients such as calcium. Individuals exhibiting this posture often display an awkward appearance during movement, which has led to associations with geek culture. This is due to the characteristic visual impression of the posture. Edward Norton is one notable individual who has been observed to exhibit this posture on certain occasions.
